description: This file defines the class SugarWebServiceUtilv4_1, extending SugarWebServiceUtilv4, providing utility methods for web services in SuiteCRM, including session validation and relationship data retrieval.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceUtilv4_1
classes.description: A utility class for SuiteCRM web services, extending core functionality with session validation and relationship fetching methods.

methods.name: validate_authenticated
methods.description: Validates if a given session ID corresponds to an active, valid session with a properly authenticated user.

methods.name: check_modules_access
methods.description: Checks if a user has the specified access ('write' or otherwise) to a given module.

methods.name: getRelationshipResults
methods.description: Retrieves related bean data for a given bean and relationship link, returning fields and related records.
